comment: A third input exists in the code, a pluck trigger that fires a 10ms noise burst into both springs (Coil.cpp:344 to :356), but its jack and its lamp are commented out of the widget (Coil.cpp:495, :496) and it is never configured with a name, so no click can reach it and it gets no line; with no jack it can never be triggered and the burst is dead code. Each coil's delay is 1.5ms plus 0.47ms times its position times the spacing (Coil.cpp:68), and legacy mode sets all of them to zero (Coil.cpp:66). The right tank is offset by -0.02 in tension and +0.03 in length (Coil.cpp:237). The wet signal is multiplied by 5 before the mix (Coil.cpp:377, :378). A patch saved before the legacy flag existed loads with legacy mode on (Coil.cpp:257, :258).
